scope: Core foundation, bounded declarative model migration HTTP/application services, signed tenant model pagination and SQL005 receipt reference integrity; partial M2 implementation
profile: core / real Docker Linux arm64 / synthetic tenants / PostgreSQL 17.11

integration.underlying_command: docker compose --env-file .local/runtime.env -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml exec -T api pnpm test:integration

historical_storage_observation.interpretation: Counts are the storage test's transaction-time observation, not a fixed tenant inventory. All recorded historical gaps remained explicit and their receipt getters failed closed.

unit.scope: Shared authorization/audit helpers, strict bounded typed-model parsing, precision-preserving migration transformations, complete-bound migration JSON-file regressions, and HMAC cursor authentication/purpose/key/length/Unicode cases.

evidence_collector.scope: Synthetic collector fixtures verify eight distinct required browser journeys, reject missing/duplicate/skipped/flaky/repeated results and failed service steps, and omit private output from published summaries. These tests do not execute product browser journeys.

runtime.image_meaning: Final signed-cursor API image on which all 35 integration tests executed. Browser qualification is recorded separately.
runtime.role_qualification: Real storage tests assert forced RLS, non-runtime table ownership, denied direct reference/exception writes and denied runtime database TEMP. The separate owner-run upgrade harness verifies owner/runtime NOSUPERUSER and NOBYPASSRLS.

source_binding.method: SHA256 read from the final running API container and independently compared with the worktree for all 45 listed files; zero mismatches. The container has no source mounts. This binds an integrated working tree and immutable image, not a claim of testing a clean committed revision.

verified: Existing tenant/RLS/CSRF/role/source validation/idempotency and typed model API/service regressions pass on the final image.

Strict model and migration file parsing rejects duplicate keys, including escaped duplicates, and supports the declared full acknowledgement bound. Typed values retain exact decimal strings and report stable validation paths.

Migration context and preview require current write permissions, complete visibility of every bound asset and an exact declaration of historical source pins. Hidden/cross-tenant scope does not expose asset identifiers, counts or values.

Authorized previews show before/after typed values. The digest binds the target definition, exact plan, current head, source definitions, asset versions, pins and attribute hashes; stale or invalid executions fail before canonical writes.
Successful execution commits the new immutable model version, complete cohort repinning, before/after asset history, receipt, production audit and outbox in one transaction.
A deliberate late production-journal hook failure rolls back every affected canonical row, revision, receipt, audit and outbox event; the unchanged preview succeeds on retry.

HTTP execution idempotency permits a corrected retry after failed validation and reauthorizes cached receipts against current write permission and original asset visibility. Rejected replay leaves the already-committed head unchanged.

Sanitized model.migration_attempt_failed records are committed after the failed request transaction and omit protected values. The event describes the failed attempt and makes no assertion that a prior successful idempotent execution rolled back.

SQL005 binds receipt identity to its plan and bounded asset metadata. Trigger-maintained normalized rows reference the same tenant's parent receipt, asset, both actual revisions and both model versions. Malformed metadata and missing/cross-tenant references fail atomically without creating exceptions for new writes.

Runtime callers cannot directly insert, update, delete or truncate normalized references or historical exceptions, and cannot create temporary auxiliary trigger tables. Nested invoker-trigger spoof and duplicate-reference defense are qualified separately by the isolated owner-run upgrade harness.
Fifteen pre-005 historical fixture revision gaps remain explicitly quarantined without invented snapshots. Reads reject any exception or incomplete normalization with MODEL_MIGRATION_STORAGE_INVALID.

Model inventory traverses 103 definitions through bounded unique pages, defaults to 50 items, caps pages at 100, treats search metacharacters literally, and authenticates HMAC-SHA256 cursors bound to tenant, actor, search, sort, page size and position. Retaining a genuine signature while changing payload fields fails; changing request filters/page size/actor/tenant also fails; an unchanged signed cursor remains valid. Missing/invalid signatures and inputs beyond 1024 characters fail.

lock_order: canonical asset rows ordered by id

prior_failures_and_resolution: The earlier full integration run passed 33 of 35 tests. A fuzzy-search fixture used a UUID fragment and matched an unrelated visible asset; the hidden asset was not returned. The fixture now uses one full unique synthetic canary token and checks protected names and identifiers directly.

The original nested-trigger setup expected runtime TEMP permission, but gc_app correctly denied CREATE TEMP. The runtime test now verifies that denial. A separate isolated owner-run harness installs the auxiliary trigger and invokes it as gc_app without granting runtime CREATE/TEMP.
The final image contains those test-only corrections. All 35 integration tests reran and passed. Applied SQL001-005 was not edited.
limitations: This report does not mark full MOD-001/002/003, AT-MOD-01, M2 or release readiness complete. Inheritance, relation constraints, glossary/reference data, other ingress, typed catalog search/filter/sort and the remaining programme remain open.

Only the bounded synchronous migration profile is implemented here. Temporal scheduling, resumable bulk migration, enterprise throughput, arbitrary conversion code, list-index mutation, forward repair and restore qualification remain outside this evidence.

Database checks enforce bounded receipt shape and tenant-scoped reference existence. Full DSL operation/value semantics, exact destructive-change acknowledgement semantics, canonical hash correctness and snapshot-content equivalence remain domain/application responsibilities.

SQL005's explicit historical exception path addresses pre-005 synthetic development fixtures; no released predecessor upgrade is claimed. Existing append-only evidence was preserved. The actual owner-run checksum-migrator backfill/rollback checks are recorded separately.

Successful application-service tests use the production journal/snapshot hooks. The late failure is deliberately injected to prove transaction rollback; it is not a naturally occurring production incident.
Browser/OIDC interaction, rendered UI inspection and accessibility are recorded separately. The six collector tests use synthetic artifact trees and do not qualify browser behavior.

The documented core launch passed on the earlier migration image. The final signed-cursor API image was activated and all 35 integration tests reran on it. No additional full dev-up execution or browser result is inferred by this report.
The earlier docs/verification/m2-model-migrations.json remains historical evidence of its own eight-test source-mounted run. It is not rebound to these newer sources.
No independent human security review, production deployment, load benchmark or supported release qualification is claimed.
Signed cursors are qualified for model inventory only. This does not establish complete SYS-API-001 coverage across every collection endpoint.

prior_verified_runs.scope: Earlier migration and unsigned-pagination checkpoint. Superseded for current-source qualification by the final signed-cursor 35-test execution above; no claim that these earlier results executed the newer cursor code.
